task: show me how to change the cursor type

evidence.description: Brand Kit → Screen Clips page ("Screen Clip Settings") is open with the Cursor Style combobox expanded, showing the three cursor-type options; the current value is still Pointer-first (unchanged).

summary:
Here's how to change the cursor type (Cursor Style) in Yarn:

1. In the left sidebar, click **Brand Kit**.
2. In the Brand Kit nav column, choose **Screen Clips** — this opens the brand-wide **Screen Clip Settings** page (currently "Default Brand").
3. In the **Cursor** section, click the **Cursor Style** dropdown (currently set to *Pointer-first*).
4. Pick one of the three options now showing: **Arrow-first**, **Pointer-first**, or **Original**. The choice applies immediately.

I navigated there and opened the dropdown so you can see the options, but I did NOT change the value — it's still *Pointer-first*. Press Escape to dismiss the list.

Scope note: this is the **brand-wide default** (Brand Kit → Screen Clips), which affects all projects using this brand. If you only want it for one video, open that project → **Project actions (⋯)** next to the voice picker → **Screen Clip Settings…** → change Cursor Style there → **Done**; that per-project override is stored separately and won't affect the brand default. Nearby cursor controls on the same page: Auto-Hide Cursor, Text Cursor (I-beam), and Cursor Scale.
